name: GeoAct-Bench
description: Evaluation materials for the paper "GeoAct: action-level access control for agentic geospatial analysis with local large language models". GeoAct is a geospatial agent that plans and executes spatial-analysis tool calls on behalf of a user in a multi-tenant spatial data infrastructure. Every tool invocation is authorised against the user's dataset-level permissions before the tool reaches storage, by a deterministic gate called the Action-Level Access-Control Enforcement Point (Action-PEP). This deposit holds the mechanism, the evaluation behind the paper, and the generators for every table and data figure in it. Contents: - code/tools.ts - the read-only GIS tool set and the dataset arguments each tool declares, which is what the Action-PEP gates. Contains the gate itself.- code/agent.ts - the Planner-Action-PEP-Executor loop. Every tool call is authorised before dispatch; denials are counted and audited.- code/geoact_bench.ts - GeoAct-Bench: builds the per-tenant plans, generates the legitimate and adversarial requests together with their ground truth, runs every condition over every planner model, and writes the results and tables.- code/geoact_conformance.ts - the gate-level harness, which needs no language model. Arm A sweeps every (tool, dataset-argument, user, dataset) combination through the enforcement path and checks both directions, unsound execution and over-blocking.
